integrity: All parameter ranges are proved analytically. Reproducible finite checks are supplied as supplementary, not exhaustive, evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns concentric right circular frusta, not arbitrary bases or oblique cones. The published Khachiyan half-cone formula coincides with one high-phase specialization; historical searches cannot eliminate all older equivalent formulations. Numerical tests are finite and independent external mathematical auditing has not been performed.
title: A John-ellipsoid transition and a three-phase local-symmetry plateau for circular frusta
